dslRule:
<!id: org.eclipse.search.FileTreeContentProvider.refreshToUpdate>
<!description: Replace TreeViewer.refresh(element) with TreeViewer.update(element, null) for performance when no structural change is expected.>
<!severity: HINT>

$viewer.refresh($element) :: instanceof($viewer, "org.eclipse.jface.viewers.TreeViewer")
=>
$viewer.update($element, null)
;;
summary: Replaces `TreeViewer.refresh(element)` with `TreeViewer.update(element, null)` to improve performance by updating only a specific node rather than refreshing the entire structure.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
